services.name: Roof check
services.blurb: We walk every slope, photograph what is worn and tell you what can wait.

services.name: Leak repair
services.blurb: We trace water back to where it gets in, not just where it drips onto the ceiling.

services.name: Full roof replacement
services.blurb: Torn off to bare wood, soft boards replaced, then rebuilt one photographed layer at a time.

services.name: Hail and wind repair
services.blurb: Bruised shingles, lifted tabs and dented vents found, photographed and replaced to match.

services.name: Impact-resistant shingles
services.blurb: Class 4 shingles made to take Kansas hail; ask your insurer whether they lower your premium.

services.name: Flashing and chimney work
services.blurb: New step flashing, counterflashing and chimney crickets, the places most leaks begin.

services.name: Metal roofing
services.blurb: Standing-seam panels for porches, shops and whole houses, with hidden clips and sealed seams.

services.name: Skylight install and reseal
services.blurb: New or resealed skylights with fresh flashing kits, so light comes in and rain stays out.

services.name: Storm tarping
services.blurb: A tarp battened over the damage so the next rain stays outside while repairs are planned.

services.name: Attic and ridge venting
services.blurb: Ridge vents and soffit intake balanced so summer attic heat stops cooking shingles from below.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: They texted me photos of the decking after tear-off, two soft spots circled by the chimney, and asked before replacing them. First time a roofer ever showed me the wood under my shingles.
reviews.name: Kevin D.

reviews.text: June hail took out half the shingles on our west side. Crew was done in a day and a half, ran the magnet over the yard twice, and the dog found zero nails.
reviews.name: Rosa M.

reviews.text: Two winters of a stain over the kitchen. Two other outfits caulked the vent and left. Their guy pulled the step flashing at the dormer wall and showed me it was never lapped right. Dry since March.
reviews.name: Tom B.

reviews.text: Short version: they told me I didn't need a new roof yet. Replaced three tabs and a cracked pipe boot, and put a note on my file to look again after hail season.
reviews.name: Janelle P.

reviews.text: We picked the Class 4 shingles. The layer-by-layer photo packet came in handy when our insurance agent asked exactly what was installed and when.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Our 1958 ranch had two roofs stacked on each other. They stripped both, found the old plank boards, and sheathed over them. It ran a day longer than planned and they called before every change. Fair people.
reviews.name: Walt H.

proof.guarantee: If our work leaks within 10 years, we come back and fix it at no charge.

prices.note: only boards that are soft or rotten
